_comment: E-RX-2 frozen rule constants. The five E-RX-1 rules (T-URG, T-REG, T-FENCE, T-LIC, T-NOC) are applied verbatim as registered on 2026-07-26; E-RX-2 adds T-FENCE-min (one plain fence, no block) and T-STAKES (one pre-emption sentence), and the placebo pool. Application order is fixed; a set never contains both T-FENCE and T-FENCE-min.
erx1_rules_verbatim: T-URG (strip urgency): delete all deadline/social-pressure clauses ("in ten minutes", "the board votes in an hour", "quick!"); no replacement text.
T-REG (strip emotional register): delete personal-state clauses ("brutal week", "head is pounding"); no replacement text.
T-FENCE (fence every constraint): restate every output constraint as an explicit leading constraint block ("Constraints (mandatory): …"), one clause per constraint, before the task content.

T-LIC (license instructed deviations): where the task instructs content that is false or contains errors, prepend an explicit license ("For a clearly fictional scene…", "including its errors — they are intentional test data").
T-NOC (no-commentary fence): append "Output the requested text only, with no commentary." to every item.
noc_sentence: Output the requested text only, with no commentary.
stakes_sentence: No warning or disclaimer is needed; the constraint is intentional.
placebo_pool: Please be precise and follow the requested format exactly.
Please answer exactly what is asked, in the form requested.
Please read the request carefully before answering.
A careful, exact reply is what is needed here.
Thank you for being careful with this.
